It was a real pleasure teaching the 6th edition of the Tunnel training.

Some exceptional displays of determination, focus and peer support. It came together beautifully in that last session with not just 'conservative' VPN configurations, of using a remote endpoint as a gateway to the www, but implementing real private LAN-like layers atop Internet infrastructure. 

Congrats to the graduates! 

#selfhosted #sysadmin #privacy
